notes: Epic -> Story -> Slice backlog. Vertical slices, each a demo-able increment (Protocol 0.8). Each slice id is stable and used as the tasks/<slice-id>.md filename and as the ACOS bridge slice id. parent_story maps a slice to its story; parent_epic maps story to epic. Effort S/M/L. dependency_order is the global build order. Demos D0-D3 (plan.md sec 4). v1 = channels 1-4 + recorder full (Decision D4); channels 5-9 phased to v2/v3.

epics.title: Diagnostics + decision lock (problem-before-solution)
epics.description: Confirm symptoms/hypotheses/unknowns; validate H1 (union of channels/pivots, not one search), H2 (blind isolation => non-circular corroboration), H3 (no hub-guard => N^2 blow-up); lock D1-D8 defaults + the free-only / stdlib-only / blocking-compliance ground rules via an acos-decide ADR.

epics.title: Skill scaffold + BLOCKING compliance gate
epics.description: Project-skill scaffold (SKILL.md command surface, explicit-invocation-only) + the blocking compliance gate that captures a permissible-purpose ComplianceRecord (DPPA/FCRA/FDCPA + GLBA hard block + scraping posture) before any external lookup.

epics.title: Cache + fetch + scraping posture
epics.description: JSON cache with freshness TTLs wrapping every external lookup; posture enforcement (public no-login pages, respect robots/rate limits); 403/rate-limit resilience; per-record freshness stamps.

epics.title: Normalize/classify + Stage-1 identity resolution
epics.description: Person-vs-entity classification + alias/maiden/Jr-Sr/variant + fuzzy match; identity resolution expanding spouse/relatives/associates (people-search = leads only, corroborate) with >=2 anchors for common names.

epics.title: Entity graph engine + hub-guard
epics.description: Temporal/provenance edges + edge-strength ordering + inverse-frequency weighting + hub-guard (stop-list + dynamic detection >=25 + hop limit 2 + log-every-prune).

epics.title: Discovery channels 1-4 + recorder index (ArcGIS / assessor / recorder / mailing pivot)
epics.description: ArcGIS REST parcel query by OWNER or MAIL_ADDR; assessor owner-name search (free states); recorder grantor-grantee index (highest-yield + name-blocked workaround); owner-search-by-state routing.

epics.title: Embedded blind swarm + between-rounds synthesizer
epics.description: swarm_dispatch builds the channel x jurisdiction x entity agent matrix per round (isolated, subscription-only Task()); synthesize_round cross-references -> confidence (Verified=2+ independent), preserves conflicts as review flags, hub-prunes + enforces the hop limit, emits next seeds; loop stops at no new high-confidence nodes.

epics.title: Entity discovery wiring + graph-expansion loop integration
epics.description: SoS + OpenCorporates entity discovery feeding the graph; wire normalize -> identity -> entity discovery -> channels -> swarm -> synthesizer into the loop-until-dry pipeline in SKILL.md (Demo 1 thin path validated end to end).

epics.title: Dedup on APN + per-owner aggregation
epics.description: Canonicalize APN; merge cross-channel duplicate parcels unioning provenance + freshness; aggregate holdings per owner/controlled-entity.

epics.title: Scoring + confidence tiers + review-flag taxonomy
epics.description: Merged scoring rubric -> score + signals; tiers >=75 high / 50-74 candidate / <50 weak; emit manual-review flags; hub-cap <=40; common-name penalty.

epics.title: Estimated equity / value / debt rollup
epics.description: Assessed value (flag 'assessed, not market') + last sale + original recorded mortgage - amortization assumption -> estimated equity; 'no mortgage data found' flag; every figure labeled estimated; never fabricate AVM/payoff.

epics.title: Report + coverage/limits footer + dry-run hardening
epics.description: Markdown dossier (compliance header -> tiers -> per-parcel evidence chain -> estimated portfolio equity -> coverage/limits footer -> review flags) with hedged language; sample dry run probing real portal availability + false-positive rate at the 75/50 cutoffs; audit trail verified.

stories.title: As the team, confirm the asset-discovery diagnosis and lock the D1-D8 defaults + ground rules so the solution is built against the real problem.
stories.user_value: Prevents building the wrong engine: validates that 'widest net' = union of channels/pivots (not one search), that blind isolation makes corroboration non-circular, and that an unguarded graph explodes; records the free-only / stdlib-only / blocking-compliance decisions.

stories.title: As a collections analyst, when I invoke the skill it refuses to do anything until a permissible-purpose record is captured.
stories.user_value: The blocking compliance gate makes every run legally defensible: no external lookup happens until DPPA/FCRA/FDCPA purpose + debt class + GLBA hard-block acknowledgment + scraping posture are recorded.

stories.title: As the pipeline, I can wrap every external lookup in a freshness-aware cache that survives 403s and rate limits and makes re-runs cheap.
stories.user_value: Resilience + resumability + auditability: cached lookups with freshness TTLs handle blocks, make re-runs cheap, and surface per-record freshness stamps in the report.

stories.title: As the pipeline, I can resolve the real person/entity behind a query, expanding aliases/spouse/associates as leads while resisting common-name false positives.
stories.user_value: Identity resolution seeds the graph correctly: person-vs-entity classification, alias/variant expansion, people-search as leads-only (corroborate), and >=2 anchors required for common names.

stories.title: As the pipeline, I can build a temporal/provenance entity graph that expands control links while a hub-guard prevents combinatorial blow-up.
stories.user_value: The graph spine works without exploding: every edge carries temporal+provenance, edges are strength-ranked, and the hub-guard (stop-list + dynamic detection + hop limit + log-every-prune) keeps precision while logging coverage honestly.

stories.title: As the pipeline, I can find parcels through channels 1-4 + the recorder index, routed by each jurisdiction's owner-search capability.
stories.user_value: Real parcels surface from the highest-yield free channels (assessor owner-name, recorder grantor-grantee index, ArcGIS mailing-address pivot, entity graph), with name-blocked states routed to the recorder workaround.

stories.title: As the pipeline, I can run isolated blind agents per round and synthesize them into corroborated nodes with conflicts preserved, pruning hubs and enforcing the hop limit.
stories.user_value: Corroboration is genuine and bounded: blind isolated agents make 'Verified = 2+ sources' non-circular; the between-rounds synthesizer preserves conflicts, prunes hubs, enforces the hop limit, and stops when a round yields no new high-confidence nodes.

stories.title: As a collections analyst, I can run a compliant thin pipeline end to end on a sample name and get a hedged Markdown report with an audit trail.
stories.user_value: Demo 1: compliance gate -> normalize -> identity -> entity discovery -> (stubbed/real) channels -> swarm -> synthesizer wired into the loop in SKILL.md, producing a hedged report stub + audit trail.

stories.title: As the pipeline, I can deduplicate parcels on APN and aggregate holdings per owner/controlled entity.
stories.user_value: One parcel found via three channels becomes one row with unioned provenance + freshness; holdings roll up per owner so the portfolio view is clean.

stories.title: As a collections analyst, I get parcels ranked into confidence tiers with explicit signals and manual-review flags.
stories.user_value: The merged scoring rubric ranks parcels >=75 high / 50-74 candidate / <50 weak with every +/- signal shown, hub-only links capped <=40, common-name matches penalized, and review flags preserving uncertainty.

stories.title: As a collections analyst, I get an estimated equity/value/debt picture from free data, with every figure clearly labeled an estimate.
stories.user_value: An estimated equity rollup (assessed value + original recorded mortgage - amortization assumption) per parcel and per portfolio, with 'no mortgage data found' flags and an explicit 'estimates, not AVMs' limitation -- never fabricated.

stories.title: As a collections analyst, I get a complete hedged dossier with a coverage/limits footer, validated by a real-name dry run.
stories.user_value: Demo 3: the full Markdown dossier (compliance header -> tiers -> per-parcel evidence chain -> estimated portfolio equity -> coverage/limits footer -> review flags) with hedged language, hardened by a dry run that probes real portal availability and the false-positive rate at the 75/50 cutoffs.
